messages:
sam: Quick PSA — final changelog sweep before cutoff at 21:00 UTC today. Please run a quick format check and add component tags if missing. Example entries should be one short sentence + optional parenthetical PR. See https://redwood.dev/docs/release-notes. Ping me if unsure.

aj: Quick q — where do we put the component tag? PR body or the changelog entry?

maria: Put it in the changelog entry itself. We parse the entry; use a short parenthetical or a suffix like "(runtime)" or "runtime" after a colon. Also include the PR number in parentheses.

lex: tiny example I copy:```
- Reduce KV cache cold-starts (runtime): tighter eviction window, ~12% latency drop. (PR #4321)
```

sam: Perfect — prefer the single-line bullet + parentheses for PR. Avoid multi-paragraph blurbs; keep it scannable.

aj: Do we want severity prefixes? e.g. Fix:, Perf:, Docs:?

maria: Short answer: yes when helpful. Use one-word prefixes sparingly. Not mandatory but helpful for the release email.

release-bot: :rotating_light: changelog freeze in effect at 21:00 UTC. Only emergency/security patches accepted post-cutoff.

lex: Ran a quick grep — found two PRs missing component tags: #4311, #4319. I'll open tiny edits to the entries.

sam: Thanks — if you can’t edit the changelog directly, drop the one-liner here and I’ll paste it into the master file.

aj: Will do in a bit, thanks :thumbsup:

maria: Small style note — aim for <=140 chars per entry when possible (helps the release email and changelog skim).

lex: A couple of helpful shortcuts: when editing the changelog, use `git add -p` + `./scripts/changelog-lint` locally to catch the tag/format nits before pushing.

sam: Great call. Thanks everyone — last pass in the next 40m.
